title: feat(studio): the publish panel names each change in words — properties by their form label, rules and groups by their label
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4i9JiKjEjwtuVzd4gKy9hB)_

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：发布前的「待发布更改」面板展开某项后，不再列裸键名（`+ sharingModel`、`+ config`、`+ validations`），改为按该类型编辑表单上的字段名称显示（Sharing Model、Columns、Validations），验证规则和字段分组逐条按名称列出新增 / 修改 / 删除。
- 为什么改：作者发布前看不懂这次到底改了什么，尤其改了哪条验证规则完全看不出来（#27835，#27521 第 28 行的命名半）。
- 风险与回滚：只改面板的展示与对比方式，不改发布行为；视图改为在 config 内一层对比。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`（`computeChangeDetail` 的视图展开与列表条目），`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/changeKeyLabels.ts`（标签取自 spec 的 `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY`），新测试 `DraftChangesPanel.namedChanges-27835.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/`，预期 40 个文件全绿；或在 Studio 改一条验证规则后点发布，展开对象，看到「~ Validations」下列出该规则名称。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27835

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The Pending changes panel (`DraftChangesPanel`) is the Studio publish summary too: `StudioDesignSurface` renders the same component in its confirm posture, so one change covers both surfaces the card names.

- **Properties by their form label.** A new leaf, `preview/changeKeyLabels.ts`, reads the item type's authoring form from the spec's `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY` (the type-to-form map `/meta/types` serves) and names a property the way the inspector's `SchemaForm` row does: the row's declared `label`, else its prettified key (`prettifyFieldName`, the helper the Studio's held line already shares). The key follows as secondary text only when the label does not spell it, `SchemaForm`'s machine-name rule. A property the form has no row for reads as its key, in monospace, as before. No key-to-label table lives in the panel. Changed field properties read through the `field` form the same way.
- **Named list entries.** The flow-node diff is generalised into one `diffListEntries(before, after, idKey)`. Flows keep calling it for `nodes` by `id` (node rows unchanged). For every other type, a top-level list whose entries carry a distinct `name` (validation rules) or `key` (field groups) gets its entries listed under the list's key row: added, changed (with what differs, by the list row's declared sub-row labels) and removed, each led by its `label`. A list of plain strings, or one with no such identity, stays one key row. The diff lands in `EntryChangeDetail.entries`, a Map keyed by the key as it appears in `keys`; `keys` itself is unchanged in shape.
- **Views one level down.** A view is a ViewItem whose inspector edits `draft.config`, so a `view` is compared inside `config` (`config.columns`), labelled from the view form. A non-view item still compares `config` whole.
- The item rows themselves already lead with the item's label under its type heading (objectui#11862); they are unchanged.

## Tests

- New `DraftChangesPanel.namedChanges-27835.test.tsx` (12 tests): form labels for object, field, view-body and flow properties; a declared sub-row label; controls for a property, a type no form names; the rule added / changed / removed and the field group changed; controls for a string list and for a flow's other lists; a new view and a view edit compared inside `config`, with a non-view control; and the rendered drill-in for both.
- Seven existing panel tests updated where they pinned the raw-key text this card changes (`+ sharingModel` → `+ Sharing Model`, `~ label` → `~ Label`, `~ edges` → `~ Edges`, `· label` → `· Label`, `+ subject` → `+ Subject`); `protectionEnvelope`'s row reader now reads field and key rows by test id instead of the monospace class. Flow node row assertions are untouched and green.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/preview/` → Test Files 40 passed (40), Tests 274 passed (274).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` → exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, mutation proven on disk, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- `formKeyLabel` returns no label (`if (row || !row) return undefined;`): 6 failed in `namedChanges-27835` + `noChangeAndKeySplit-11807`, restored.
- Named-list entries never recorded (`listEntryRowCount(list) < 0`): 3 failed in `namedChanges-27835`, restored.
- View not compared inside `config` (`type === 'NOT_view'`): 3 failed in `namedChanges-27835`, restored.

No build step: the panel tests import the source directly.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- View, validation rule, field and object changes now name the item in words; property keys read as their form labels where the type's form has a row; flow node naming unchanged. Reading taken: a row with no declared `label` counts as "a form label", the prettified key the inspector itself shows (most spec form rows declare none), and a property with no form row falls back to its key.
- Labels are the spec's English form labels in every locale. The inspector's own zh overlays (`translateSchemaFieldLabel`, the dashboard `metadataForms` bundle) live in the metadata-admin string table, which this panel's eager graph must not import (the reason recorded on `computeChangeDetail`). A zh author therefore reads English property labels here, as on most inspector rows; noted, not filed.
- A form row with no declared label whose schema carries a `title` shows that title in the inspector (`SchemaForm` reads the JSON schema) but its prettified key here; this panel holds no JSON schema. Noted, not filed.
- Importing `@objectstack/spec/system` adds no new eager weight: every `@objectstack/*` module already rides the console's `vendor-objectstack` chunk (the measurement recorded in the panel's import comment).
- No i18n key was added or changed: the list-entry rows reuse the field-row shape under the list's own key row.

## Verification

Local derived gates on head `b4396c78`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 34 families; all 34 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciled "34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` → "0 new citation(s)". Every family CI runs is read from this PR's checks.
